newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pacific Hydro in A$530 mln power deal.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pacific Hydro in A$530 mln power deal.

text.p: Small electricity generator Pacific Hydro Ltd said on Monday it had signed a deal to become a one third partner in a consortium to build a hydro-electric power plant in the Philippines for about A$185 million.

It said the consortium, which included Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc and Ever Electrical Manufacturing Inc, had agreed to supply electricity to the Philippines' state-owned National Power Corp worth more than A$530 million over 25 years.
The project will be on the Bakun river in the Philippines.
"The Bakun project is planned to enter into its construction phase early in 1997 following financial closing and construction is due to be completed by June 2000," Pacific Hydro said.
"Negotiations for the construction contract and project financing are currently being undertaken," it said.
